programs=base/'programs'; programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 2]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells); r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells); c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
    marks = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 2)]
    def paint(r, c):
        if out[r][c] == 0:
            out[r][c] = 2
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        left = any(rr == r and cc < c0 for rr, cc in marks)
        right = any(rr == r and cc > c1 for rr, cc in marks)
        if left:
            for c in range(c1 + 1, w): paint(r, c)
        if right:
            for c in range(0, c0): paint(r, c)
        if not left and not right:
            for c in range(w): paint(r, c)
    for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
        above = any(cc == c and rr < r0 for rr, cc in marks)
        below = any(cc == c and rr > r1 for rr, cc in marks)
        if above:
            for r in range(r1 + 1, h): paint(r, c)
        if below:
            for r in range(0, r0): paint(r, c)
        if not above and not below:
            for r in range(h): paint(r, c)
    return out
'''
